notes.title: update 148
notes.content: Added a cheat code to disable hiding of words (hold F1 for 5 sec)

notes.title: Keyboard input in layout editor
notes.content:
pressing keys on keyboard while in the select letter menu in layout editor is implemented
 added option to hide screen shake
 writing a space at the beginning of every line off indented paragraphs no longer necessary
 starting game with speed indicator hidden for new users
 games gives a warning if your keyboard layout doesn't match the onscreen keyboard

notes.title: preformace update
notes.content: This is an attempt at fixing performance issue that happens at high typing speeds.

notes.title: update 138
notes.content:
Slight color shift of the words that isn't unlocked 
 Fixed spelling errors in hint text of the speed indicator

notes.title: Hide keyboard and speed indicator
notes.content:
Added the ability to hide the keyboard layout and the speed indicator. 
 Integrated steam cloud saving. 
 Reduced cpu usage while idle.

notes.title: ajustable font size
notes.content: added a slider in the pause menu to ajust the font size

notes.title: Update-124
notes.content: You can now press space to get to a new line, not only enter. Pressing enter still gives you a "ding" sound.

notes.title: update - 117
notes.content: fixed a bug that reduced performance. Should work a bit better on older computers now

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Upgraded the way writing speed is displayed, removed the accuracy score. 
fixed scrolling bug in fullscreen mode on some monitors 
improved preformance while scrolling, it's now 15 times faster.

notes.title: Art update
notes.content: Did a considerable amount of work on the art
